policy: Coverage is ready when at least two fresh independent discovery families have current positive candidate yield, including one broad marketplace and one independent classifieds/MLS family, every priority building has at least one fresh usable official source, and each priority building has a fresh semantically valid inventory-page snapshot. A partial MLS snapshot may contribute exact positive discovery rows but never disappearance or removal evidence. Aggregate counts alone never publish inventory or create target-scope gaps; only structured 2–4BR rows inside the configured rent scope do. Structured rows with exact rent, bedroom and sqft anchors may be tracked as verified floorplans when the page also has current availability language.
